added.member: UI documents: border, outline and box-shadow
added.summary: Standard CSS borders and outlines on any element: the border and outline shorthands and their longhands (per-side width, style and colour, outline-offset), styles none, hidden, solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge, inset and outset, and currentColor. A border pads the box (border-box); an outline takes no room, so :focus-visible { outline: … } replaces the core focus ring. box-shadow takes a comma list of [inset] x y [blur [spread]] [colour], outer shadows under the background and inset ones over it.

overflow, overflow-x and overflow-y take visible, hidden, clip, scroll and auto as CSS Overflow 3 defines them (visible beside a non-visible axis computes to auto); auto and scroll scroll that axis, hidden and clip clip the children. scrollbar-width: none hides a scrolling box's bars.

fixed.summary: A display: block box with an auto width fills its block parent's content width, as in CSS block flow, instead of shrinking to its content.
